rca_findings.root_cause: The final full-resume coherence judge panel produced fewer model-backed verdicts than the required quorum, so final aggregation stayed blocked even though the generated section lanes may have product-authorized evidence.

causal_allocation.dominant_cause: The final aggregation judge panel could not count enough model-backed full-resume coherence verdicts to satisfy quorum.
causal_allocation.retry_recoverability_reason: A rerun can recover after repairing the provider artifact path/transport blocker; blind reruns before that fix reproduce the same zero-quorum result.

allocation.required_work: Make X1D provider request/response artifact paths compact and long-path safe before provider calls run.

implementation_plan: Repair X1D full-resume judge artifact persistence and provider transport so Gemini/OpenAI request and response artifacts can be written under long run roots.
